name: autochub-vscode
description: Offline Context Hub code graphology analyzer and deprecation agent natively in VS Code.

commands.title: Auto-CHUB: Analyze Full Workspace and Show Report
Auto-CHUB: Analyze Current File and Show Report

autochub.cliPath.description: Absolute path to the custom autochub executable. If empty, the extension attempts to use the adjacent CLI project path or npx fallback.

autochub.githubRepo.description: CHUB GitHub source for sync in the format owner/repo@branch.

autochub.autoSyncOnStartup.description: Automatically sync CHUB docs on extension activation.

autochub.enableGraphAnalysis.description: Enable transitive call-graph propagation to catch indirect deprecated API usage.

autochub.includeLiveChubLookup.description: Use live chub CLI lookups while analyzing (slower, needs network).

autochub.runOnType.description: Analyze while typing with a debounce. Keep disabled for large workspaces.

autochub.maxResults.description: Maximum findings returned from each analyze run.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
